experiment_role: Reference-only method-extraction pilot for numerical self-disagreement; not threshold calibration

interpretation_limits.note: These values demonstrate that Reference-only coarse-versus-two-half uncertainty extraction is executable and reproducible. They do not define a scientific acceptance threshold and may not be used alone to classify RossFast.

next_permitted_action: Freeze exact Reference-only calibration levels across the intended six-material E0 domain before broad calibration execution. Only after that dataset is generated may a threshold formula and any stratification be frozen, still without inspecting new RossFast results.
